key_events: I was a farmer's son, but I joined the guard after the bandit raids a few years ago. Someone has to keep watch.
My job is to patrol the main gate and the village square. I know everyone, and I notice everything.

I see Elian running around, always looking stressed. I see the Blacksmith (Baelor) grumbling at outsiders. I see the Herbalist (Elara) collecting her plants. It's my job to know the patterns of this village.
